text:
Alex: Heads up — starting Odd Lane private deployment preflight. Main items: egress/NAT, registry image sync, cert rotation, KMS integration. I’ll coordinate owners.
Maria: Thanks — netops who can own NAT/egress config? @Ken? also need list of outbound endpoints/ports.
Ken (netops): I can own NAT/egress. Need firewall rule list + target IPs/CIDRs. ETA end of day to open CR.
Alex: Basic network layout: tenant CIDR 10.2.3.0/24 -> NAT through nat-ol-01 -> outbound only to S3 endpoints and the customer SIEM. Rules we expect: outbound 443 to S3 region endpoints, 443 to syslog host.
Alex: suggested sg snippet:
```
# example: allow outbound to s3 region
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-ol123 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 52.216.0.0/14
```
Jordan: Security note — we need KMS plan for customer keys and confirmation if HSM required for onprem. Priya, can you confirm cert rotation cadence for airgapped installs?
Priya: For on-prem/airgap we can't rely on public CA automation. Plan: pre-signed cert bundle + offline signing process. Rotation cadence 90 days recommended; propose automations in ops-runbook.
security-bot: Reminder: private deployment checklist requires CIS baseline scan + evidence upload to compliance@redwood. Don’t forget attestations. :warning: 
Maria: Blocker — registry image sync failing with 403 when pulling from customer mirror. Logs show token expired. @Sam (infra) any quick fixes?
Sam (infra): Confirmed token expiry. Workaround: restart sync job with refreshed token. Steps: `kubectl delete pod registry-sync-xxxxx` then `kubectl apply -f registry-sync-job.yaml` — we’ll add token auto-refresh next sprint.
Alex: Also, can someone review the private-deploy PR that includes the network change + runbook updates? PR #142. @Jordan can you take a look?
Jordan: I’ll review in ~2 hours. Heads up: we should add a rollback step that routes requests back to hosted inference (fast failover) in the runbook.
Ken (netops): Firewall rules look OK but request explicit SG for outbound 443 to these S3 prefixes + restrict SSH 22 to corp jumpbox only. I’ll open the CR and get netops change window.
Maria: Who owns the cutover runbook and on-call list for the cutover window? Need names + pager rotations.
Alex: I’ll own the runbook. High-level checklist: 
- cert swap (priya)
- image promote (infra)
- smoke tests (qa)
- rollback path to hosted (jordan)
- notify customer and support (maria)
I’ll post a detailed timeline by EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy-trigger: canary started for oddlane-ol-01 — triggered by @Alex.
Maria: :thumbsup: smoke tests executing now (connectivity, simple gen, embedding sanity).
Alex: Canary smoke passed but noticed higher egress latency to S3 (~400ms p99). @Ken (netops) can you triage MTU/path?
Ken (netops): Looking — I see an MTU mismatch on the gateway path and a small TCP MSS clamping issue. Will push a route/MTU fix and re-run tests in 20m.
Alex: If net fix not in 1h, fallback plan: route traffic to hosted model endpoint as emergency. Documented in runbook.
Priya: Also confirm audit logs shipping to customer SIEM — need syslog/HTTPS endpoint. Send endpoint and creds to me via secure channel.
Jordan: PR #142 merged after review. I updated the rollback section and tagged the release for tomorrow 08:00 UTC. I’ll fill the postmortem template if we hit any gaps.
Alex: Great work — closing loop for now. If any blocker remains ping this thread; we’ll re-sync in 2h or earlier. :rocket:
